summary: TOP Ships Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing amendments to two related-party transactions. The first amendment extends the deadline for a $16.1 million balance owed to Central Mare Inc. for the acquisition of Tanker SPVs to July 31, 2026. The second extends to the same date an option to acquire Dubai residential real estate assets (estimated value >$200M) at a 10% discount, for which $23.5M in advance payments have been made. The extensions were requested to evaluate geopolitical conditions in the Middle East. No new event triggers a special situation; amendments to existing terms maintain the status quo pending further evaluation.
